description: This test validates that a user can successfully log in using Google authentication and is redirected to the dashboard.
steps: Click on the Google authentication button.
Assert that the Google login interface is displayed.
Enter valid Google credentials and complete the login process.
Verify that the user is redirected to the dashboard page.
Validate that the dashboard displays the correct user information.
expected_results: The user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.
edge_cases: User closes the Google login interface before completing authentication.
User's Google account lacks the necessary permissions.
data_requirements: Access to the Google authentication service.
Predefined user profile in the system linked to the Google account.
Access to the dashboard page after login.
Valid client ID and redirect URI for Google OAuth.
dependencies: Google authentication integration is correctly configured.
The user has an active internet connection.
The dashboard page is accessible after successful login.
api_interactions: Google OAuth API for user authentication.
Internal API to fetch user-specific dashboard data after login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Google login interface.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google authentication button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Provide alternative text for the authentication button.
Verify that the Google login interface is screen-reader friendly.
